calibrated_on: Li et al. 2022 Al/Si sample 1 (12 points, 82-705 K); objective: log error + 0 x (slope >400 K error)^2
local_eq_note: measured G in a partial local-equilibrium convention: fraction f(T) = 1/(1+(T_L/T)^n) of the Zeng-Chen correction (H15c); n fixed, T_L fitted on the Al/Si curve with alpha, b frozen
spec_efficiency_note: fit to MACE-AGF at 300 K, two valence classes (III-V/IV vs all other pairs); spec_efficiency: 10 pairs, LOO mean abs dev 14%; spec_efficiency_hetero: 4 pairs, LOO mean abs dev 29%
w_diffuson_note: fit to Li 2022 Al/native-SiO2/Si G(T) assuming 1.5 nm oxide (1.0 nm -> 0.24, 2.0 nm -> 0.32); Sandell stacks not used in this fit
